## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
ROTATION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Risk score negative vs Cycle score positive (Industrial Strength ABOVE TREND; CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) ↑ rising) and weakness in Tech (XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) ↓ falling) while defensives/cyclicals (XLE, XLU, XLP) are ABOVE TREND.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit conditions improving: Credit spread 0.7228 (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -1.15%) → flat, HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +0.10%) and LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +1.30%) suggesting easing credit. Fear creeping up: VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.55%) ↑ rising. Reflation signals present: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) ↑ rising.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-easing financial conditions: TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.07%) ↑ rising, UUP in CORRECTION (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +1.69%) → flat, and the Yield Curve (Level 1.0918) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND hints at modest steepening.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Defensive and Energy leadership: XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%) ↑ rising, XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +9.34%) ↑ rising, XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) ↑ rising; Tech lagging: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) ↓ falling. Style: Rotation toward defensives/energy and selective cyclicals.

**5. US vs Global?**
US softening: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -1.36%) ↓ falling; EM/Europe outperforming parts: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.38% | 1M: +3.01%) → flat and EWJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +8.40%) ↑ rising. China weakness persistent: FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -7.95%) ↓ falling.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Mixed/speculation fragile: Speculation Index (0.1063) 1W: +3.61% | 1M: -4.99% ↑ rising RECOVERY, ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -7.64%) ↑ rising, while IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -26.37%) ↓ falling signals risk-off in crypto.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Reflation bias: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) ↑ rising and CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) ↑ rising. Gold in RECOVERY: GLD (1W: +3.23% | 1M: -2.19%) ↑ rising, silver volatile: SLV RECOVERY (1W: +10.92% | 1M: -19.52%) ↑ rising.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy showing strength: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) ↑ rising and UGA ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +7.56%) ↑ rising; natural gas stress: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -20.72%) ↓ falling.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Breadth 7/11 and Energy/Utilities/Staples are ABOVE TREND (XLE, XLU, XLP) supporting rotation. DIVERGENCE: Major weakness in Tech (XLK BELOW TREND 1W & 1M negative) versus strength in defensives and energy — a sector-rotation divergence to monitor.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to defensive/cyclicals showing strength: XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%), XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) and XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +9.34%); reduce exposure to Tech (XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%)) and crypto (IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -26.37%)). Bonds (TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.07%)) remain a ballast.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND, XLU (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND, XLRE (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +7.32%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: XLK (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND, XLF (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.72%) BELOW TREND, FXI (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -7.95%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) ABOVE TREND, CPER (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: UNG (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -20.72%) BELOW TREND; SLV (1W: +10.92% | 1M: -19.52%) RECOVERY — watch volatility.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.55%) ↑ rising) as a fear threshold, HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health; HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +0.10%) vs LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +1.30%)), XLK/ XLF pivot near current Tech vs Financials spread (Tech weakness vs defensive strength), IBIT 1W decline flags downside risk for crypto.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive supporting rotation toward defensives and cyclical reflation assets. XLE, XLU and XLP showing relative strength while XLK and FXI are notable weaknesses to monitor for spillover.
